description: Recommended `skillOverrides` patch for ~/.claude/settings.json. v2 inverts the default: everything is `name-only` unless a hand-owned list says otherwise, because description budget is scarce and orchestrator-dispatched sub-skills do not need one. Do NOT auto-apply — merge via `node claude-config.js skills --apply` or by hand.

visibility_legend.on: Name + description in Claude context; appears in / menu. (platform default)
visibility_legend.name-only: Name only in Claude context; `Skill(name)` dispatch STILL WORKS; appears in / menu.
visibility_legend.user-invocable-only: Hidden from Claude context; appears in / menu (user can invoke).
visibility_legend.off: Hidden from Claude context; hidden from / menu.

policy.why: Two hard limits apply to the listing (docs/native-capabilities.md 'Skill listing budget'): 1,536 chars per skill and 1% of the context window overall. Over budget the platform keeps names and drops descriptions starting with the least-invoked skills — silently. A description is only worth its budget when Claude must recognise the skill UNPROMPTED. An orchestrator-dispatched sub-skill does not qualify: the orchestrator's own body carries the routing table, and dispatch keeps working at name-only.
policy.evidence: Measured 2026-08-04: of a 173-entry listing, 112 rendered as bare names while only 38 were our own name-only choices — the rest were budget-dropped, including three of the four skills CLAUDE.md §3 excludes from name-only precisely because they must self-trigger. A controlled overlay (166 forced to name-only) restored descriptions to all four, proving name-only returns its chars to the shared budget. Full method + honesty boundaries: tests/orchestrator-routing/RESULTS-2026-08-04.md.
policy.generated_by: tools/skill-visibility/generate.js  (recommended_overrides is COMPUTED; the three lists below are hand-owned)

keep_on.gsd-pipeline-orchestrator: Auto mainline entry (CLAUDE.md §3). Must be recognised from a plain 'plan and build X' with no skill named.
keep_on.uiux-product-orchestrator: Auto mainline entry (CLAUDE.md §3). Must be recognised from a direction-level visual ask.
keep_on.enterprise-qa-testing: Auto mainline entry (CLAUDE.md §3). Must be recognised from 'about to release / set up E2E / CI gate'.
keep_on.appsec-security-orchestrator: Auto mainline entry (CLAUDE.md §3). Must be recognised from 'before we deploy / is this secure'.
keep_on.idea-to-requirements-orchestrator: Auto mainline entry (CLAUDE.md §3). Must be recognised from a raw idea / requirements ask.
keep_on.discoverability-orchestrator: Auto mainline entry (CLAUDE.md §3 / §7). Must be recognised from a cross-channel findability ask.
keep_on.web-seo: CLAUDE.md §3 requires self-triggering; explicitly excluded from name-only. Was budget-dropped anyway before this policy.
keep_on.web-aeo: CLAUDE.md §3 requires self-triggering; explicitly excluded from name-only. Was budget-dropped anyway before this policy.
keep_on.web-local-seo: CLAUDE.md §3 requires self-triggering; explicitly excluded from name-only. Was budget-dropped anyway before this policy.
keep_on.app-aso: CLAUDE.md §3 requires self-triggering; explicitly excluded from name-only.
keep_on.pentest-scope-and-roe: Visible governance gate (CLAUDE.md §3) — it exists to remind Claude to confirm ROE before any active testing. Hiding it defeats its purpose. allowed-tools: Read only.
keep_on.guide: Top-level user guide for this config. No orchestrator dispatches it, and it answers 'how do I use this' — needs to be recognisable unprompted.
keep_on.arch-viz: Standalone: no orchestrator dispatches it. Answers 'visualize the architecture' directly.
keep_on.codegraph-cli: Standalone: no orchestrator dispatches it. Answers 'who calls X / blast radius' directly.
keep_on.codex-dispatch: Standalone: no orchestrator dispatches it. Owns cross-model delegation, referenced by rules/common/task-execution-protocol.md as a trigger-word skill.
keep_on.discoverability-growth: Standalone growth layer under L12; the discoverability orchestrator does not dispatch it by name.
keep_on.motion-engineering: Standalone: no orchestrator dispatches it by name.
keep_on.workflow-creator: Standalone: no orchestrator dispatches it; user asks for a workflow in plain language.

manual_gates.claude-env-bootstrap: Bootstrap has side effects (writes files, copies skills, modifies CLAUDE.md). manual-first by design (CLAUDE.md §2) — must not auto-fire on phrases like 'project setup'.
manual_gates.authorized-pentest-validation: Active security validation MUST NEVER auto-trigger. Defense in depth: disable-model-invocation:true in SKILL.md AND hidden from Claude here. NOTE: name-only would NOT be safe — it keeps Skill(name) dispatch working.
manual_gates.anchor-prototype-wave: Multi-surface production wave with parallel subagents. Expensive; requires explicit user trigger.
manual_gates.brutalist-skill: Experimental L3 style — requires explicit user opt-in by name.
manual_gates.output-skill: Requires explicit user opt-in by name.

merge_strategy.preferred:
node claude-config.js skills            (dry-run diff vs live settings.json)
node claude-config.js skills --apply    (additive merge into ~/.claude/settings.json)
merge_strategy.manual: Open ~/.claude/settings.json, locate top-level `skillOverrides`, merge entries from `recommended_overrides`. Additive merge — do not blind-replace keys you did not review.
merge_strategy.rollback: claude-config.js backs settings.json up before writing. Dated fallbacks live in ~/.claude/backups/<date>/.

known_limits: skillOverrides lives in live settings.json, a `claude-config.js` PRESERVE key — it is not distributed by install.sh/.ps1. Without the `skills` subcommand this list does not survive a reinstall or a new machine (ledger [ctx-1]).

The dispatched-vs-standalone split behind keep_on was derived by checking whether a skill's name appears in an orchestrator's SKILL.md or references/. That is substring matching: `guide` matched the ordinary English word and was rescued by hand. Treat the computed remainder as reviewed-by-human, not proven.
